title: Umurinzi uri ku nkengero z'uruzi
intro: Mu gihugu aho itegeko ry’umunyagitugu ryateje agahinda ingo nyinshi, umuntu yakiriye ubutumwa bwatsinze ubwoba bwose. Bafite umutima wuzuye icyizere, batangiye igikorwa cyo kwizera cyahinduraga icyerekezo cy’igihugu. Uko amazi yatwaraga imizigo y’agaciro, ibyiringiro bivanze n’imigezi.
clues: Nategetswe kudatinya cyangwa ngo ngire agahinda.
Nashyize umwana wanjye mu gasanduku maze nyishyira hejuru y'amazi.
Umwana wanjye yabonetse mu rugo rw'umutegetsi, ariko undi mwana wanjye yaramukurikiye.
Nasubiye kubonana n'umwana wanjye kugira ngo njye kumwonsa, nk'uko Allah yabinsezeranyije.

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
